# Google Search

> Google Search is a comprehensive search platform combining traditional web search with AI-powered features, visual search, voice capabilities, and augmented reality for discovering information across multiple modalities.

Google Search offers users multiple ways to find information through AI Overviews powered by Gemini, visual search via Lens and Circle to Search, voice search, AR visualization, and personalized content discovery. The platform integrates cutting-edge generative AI technology with traditional search capabilities to serve diverse user needs.

## Key Topics

- AI Overviews
- AI Mode
- Google Lens
- Circle to Search
- Voice Search
- Augmented Reality
- Gemini
- Visual Search
- Generative AI
- Mobile Search
- Search Features
- Google App
- Image Recognition
- Multimodal Search
- Personalization

## AI-Powered Search

- [AI in Search](https://search.google/ai-in-search): Overview of AI integration in Google Search including Gemini and AI Overviews.
- [Google AI Overviews - Search anything, effortlessly](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ai-overviews): AI Overviews feature page for generative AI-powered search results.
- [Google AI Mode - a new way to search, whatever's on your mind](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ai-mode): AI Mode feature powered by Gemini for deep research and multimodal search.

## Visual & Multimodal Search

- [Lens](https://search.google/ways-to-search/lens): Google Lens visual search feature for camera-based image recognition.
- [Circle to Search](https://search.google/ways-to-search/circle-to-search): Circle to Search gesture feature for Android visual search capability.
- [AR](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ar): Augmented reality search feature for virtual try-ons and 3D visualization.

## Search Methods & Features

- [Voice](https://search.google/ways-to-search/voice): Voice search feature including hands-free search and song identification.
- [Discover](https://search.google/ways-to-search/discover): Discover feature for personalized content curation and interest-based search.
- [Google App](https://search.google/google-app): Google App product page showcasing mobile search features and capabilities.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://search.google): Google Search homepage featuring Lens, AI Overviews, voice search, and AR.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://search.google/tips-tricks): How-to guide for Google Search tips, shortcuts, and feature usage.
